sources: Hit structure, keys and frames: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0036_jsspsi_* (game 1.6) and efsim kit-draft v2. Battle skill, combo and ultimate hits come from ability entities (*_abilityrange*) spawned by the skill; their frames are the spawn frame plus the entity's own DamageAction frames, and they land even if Si starts another skill (detached, from their events). Values: SkillPatchTable, potentials from PotentialTalentEffectTable (P1 +0.5 s Immobilization and +0.07 record rate; P2 combo ATK buff; P3 ×1.2 ultimate atk_scale/atk_scale_2/enhance_final; P5 ×1.15 combo atk_scale/atk_scale2/atk_scale2_1 and potential5 = 1). Talents: CharGrowthTable talentNodes (talent 0 Proxy's Patronage → buff_chr_0036_jsspsi_talent2_1/_2, coolDown −10/−20; talent 1 Unsoiled Brush → buff_chr_0036_jsspsi_talent1_1/_2, ratio_speed 0.15/0.30 for duration_speedup 5 s). Plan: docs/kit-batches/batch-1/chr_0036_jsspsi.md (pass 3).

Battle skill hit (normal_skill_abilityrange_1 = atk_scale) matches exactly in fixtures zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37 (P5), zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f (P5) and zmdlogs-b7b3762d5da8 (P1). In 40d9a3c1da37 every Si hit was 3.83% low until her build there was given attributeNodes 2: nodes chr_0036_jsspsi_5 and _7 (+15 and +20 Wisd, her main attribute) need trust 300, which the log doesn't record; with them off, battle skill, basic attack and ultimate hits there all match exactly.

Basic attacks 1–4 are mapped to their log events: attack 1 (both hits, one key) matches in zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37 (2 of 2), attacks 1 and 2 at Corrosion level 2 in zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f and zmdlogs-bdf223db8e49. Their other hits there are under Corrosion and match no level (the log check tolerates that): some sit just past a whole second of Corrosion while showing one tick fewer (ZMDLogs timestamps fall on a ~110 ms grid, so a hit can be logged up to ~0.11 s late). Corrosion ticks in zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f run on the enemy's time: 0 ticks at 0.68/1.03 s, 1 at 1.47/2.04 s, 2 at 2.39/2.50 s and still 2 at 4.19 s after three combo casts (each with a 0.8 s time dilation) at 3.53 s, 3 from 4.32 s.

Artful Intent's burst (Fixed DMG, damageType 8: normal_skill_inkmove_2 / _inkmark_projhit / _inboom_projhit) is 0.20 (P5: ink_damage_rate 0.13 + 0.07) × the sum of every logged hit on the target from Si's battle-skill hit (inclusive) to the end of Artful Intent, within the per-hit rounding: uncapped 301679 in zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f, 432652 in zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37, 530319 in zmdlogs-bdf223db8e49, 401585 in fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-e82d45c46040 (the fixtures' `value` is capped by the enemy's remaining HP). Recording stops 335–699 ms before the burst: Final Stroke ends Artful Intent at its frame 12 and the Inksoul's burst lands 13 frames later; on expiry without an Inksoul the mark projectile lands 14 frames later. Mechanism: BuffData xianjing_inkhurteffect ability event 12 group 1 (SaveDamageContext → EntityBB_ink_damage += ink_damage × ink_damage_rate), on every hit, no cooldown.

Combo: the 10 atk_scale hits (P5 ×1.15) match exactly in zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37 only with +100% DMG bonus the log doesn't list: Jade Vessel (wpn_claym_0018) combo_dmg_up 0.6 at skill level 8 (buff_wpn_claym_0018_normal_skill_comboimbue_atk) + Type 50 Yinglung (buff_equipsuit_atk_02_addcombodamage_buff) 0.2 per stack, here 2 stacks; and in zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f with +130% = 0.7 (level 9) + 3 stacks, all 10 hits exact once the log's buff_chr_0034_typhoea_combo_enemy_debuff is dropped (its damageModifier needs decorate mask 33554432 and a slowed target, so it doesn't apply to Si) and Corrosion level 2 has 2 ticks at 4.19 s and 3 from 4.32 s. Both bonuses are now equipment kits (wpn_claym_0018, suit_atk02), which ZMDLogs doesn't log, so `zmdlogs check` predicts the slashes without them.

buffs.label: Artful Intent (damage record)
buffs.note: Created by the battle-skill hit (normal_skill_abilityrange_1) for `duration` (20 s). While active it records ink_damage_rate (0.13, +0.07 at P1) × the damage of every hit its target takes, from anyone (reactions and ticks included): BuffData ability event 12, group 1, SaveDamageContext + SimpleCalcBB `EntityBB_ink_damage += ink_damage × ink_damage_rate`. It runs on the enemy's clock (zmdlogs-bdf223db8e49: about 21.7 s, 20 s + the P1 Immobilization freeze + combo slow-downs). Ends early at Final Stroke's frame 12; its end bursts (trigger artful_intent_end).

buffs.label: Inksoul
buffs.note: BuffData xianjing_linkline, created by Initial Stroke at frame 8: "lasts as long as the remaining duration of Artful Intent", so it has no duration of its own and ends with Artful Intent (trigger artful_intent_end). Gates Final Stroke (normal_skill_2) and decides the burst's path.

buffs.label: Ultimate: Cryo and Heat Amp
buffs.note: Description: Si "grants temporary Cryo Amp and Heat Amp to the entire team." buff_chr_0036_jsspsi_atk_buff_2 (CreateBuffAction at ultimate entity frame 62 on every team member, assigning enhance_final and duration = enhance_duration): two enabled EnhancedActions of rate enhance_final, logged as buff_common_affixes_enhance_crystal and buff_common_affixes_enhance_fire (amp 0.432 at level 12 and P3 in zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37, 0.36 at P1 in zmdlogs-b7b3762d5da8). Applied by trigger ultimate_effects at frame 62.

buffs.label: P2: ATK after the combo
buffs.note: BuffData combo_potential2 (attr 2 ATK, stackingType 2 max 1), created at combo entity frame 0 with potential2_count = potential2_base + potential2_enhance × n, n = the stacks the combo's trigger consumed + potential5 (SkillData combo_skill_abilityrange IfElse #15: +1 when potential5 ≥ 1). PotentialTalentEffectTable potential_2 sets the keys; below P2 potential2_duration is 0 and the buff isn't applied. zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37 logs ATK 0.20 = 0.08 + 0.03 × (3 + 1).

buffs.label: Unsoiled Brush: Haste
buffs.note: Talent 2 (Unsoiled Brush): "when the Inksoul disappears, allied operators gain 15% / 30% Haste for 5 s". BuffData talent1_speedup (SpeedupAction, stackingType 1 priority ratio_speed: strongest only), created by xianjing_inkboom / xianjing_linkline. 0 s while the talent isn't learned, so it's skipped. What Haste speeds up is assumed (in-game test 19).

triggers.note: CharGrowthTable: "COMBO TRIGGER: When an enemy's Cryo Infliction or Heat Infliction is consumed or absorbed." A reaction that consumes the infliction counts (zmdlogs-bdf223db8e49: Si's battle skill at 2140 ms, a Cryo burst at 7371 ms, Lizhiyan's Nature reaction on the Cryo, buff_common_natural_triggered, at 8152 ms, Si's combo at 11940 ms, inside the 6 s window), and so does Laevatain's Final Strike absorption of Heat (a consumption by her team trigger). The window keeps the largest count consumed ("highest stacks … from a single target"), which the combo reads as eventCount.

SkillData ultimate_skill_abilityrange and _abilityrange_1 (spawned at frame 0) at their frame 62: CreateBuff atk_buff_2 on the team, and (talent 0, Proxy's Patronage) GetCharBySquadSlot slotIndex 0 + SetSkillCdAtOnce skillTypeMask 64 (combo) by the talent buff's coolDown (−10 / −20 s; 0 while not learned). Detached like the entity: the ultimate's earliest cancel is frame 64, so it makes no difference today.
P2's ATK buff at combo entity frame 0 (the cast); the cast event carries the window's count.
SkillData normal_skill_1: CreateBuff xianjing_linkline (the Inksoul pulled from the target) at frame 8.

SkillData normal_skill_2: CreateBuff xianjing_inkboom at frame 12, which ends Artful Intent (recording stops here: 335–699 ms before the logged bursts). Cut short before frame 12, it does nothing and Artful Intent runs to expiry.

hits.label: Artful Intent burst (Inksoul returns)
hits.note: SkillData normal_skill_inkmove_2 (cast through the Inksoul): DamageAction damageType 8 (Fixed DMG) of the recorded ink_damage, poise ink_poise = ink_boom_poise; 13 frames after the end ($distancecount 1; 20 at distance 2, not modelled). Logged in zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f, -40d9a3c1da37 and pending -e82d45c46040.

hits.label: Artful Intent burst (no Inksoul)
hits.note: Description: "When Artful Intent expires and no Inksouls are present, it bursts." BuffData xianjing_inkhurteffect on end: LaunchProjectile inkmark_projhit (damageType 8, the recorded value), landing 14 frames later (zmdlogs-bdf223db8e49: burst at 24321 ms).

triggers.note: The two hits actions are judged when they run, before the third ends the Inksoul. Values (poise) from the battle skill.
Talent 2: "when the Inksoul disappears" (BuffData xianjing_inkboom / xianjing_linkline create talent1_x).

hits.label: Basic attack 1, hit 1
hits.note: Logged as chr_0036_jsspsi_attack1; matches in zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37 (t=9147, 9334). Unmapped: see sources (Corrosion tick vs log timestamp in zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f t=4646).

hits.label: Basic attack 1, hit 2
hits.note: Same event key as hit 1 (atk_scale1 = atk_scale2 at every level).
Logged as chr_0036_jsspsi_attack3; zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f t=5659 (2.04 s into Corrosion) shows 1 tick, the floor-of-seconds model says 2. Unmapped until the log check allows for timestamp granularity.

skills.label: Basic attack 4
skills.note: A channel (ChannelingAction frames 5–40, ends early on move input: a rotation choice, not modelled).

hits.note: At most 6 hits per target, 0.1 s apart (display_atk_scale = 6 × atk_scale). Logged as chr_0036_jsspsi_attack4 (only 3 hits in zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f; the third is stamped at the following combo cast). chr_0036_jsspsi_attack4_abilityrange isn't spawned from any file and was never logged.

skills.label: Basic attack 5 (final strike)
skills.note: Two branches, one hit either way. Not yet logged.

hits.note: SkillData attack5: ObtainCostAction costType 1 atb (20) when controlled, DamageAction mask 2097280 (Final Strike), DefiniteValueCalculation poise (18) onlyEnableForMainChar.

skills.label: Finisher
skills.note: Four BreakingAttackCalculation landings at frames 3, 12, 21, 37 carrying multiplier 0.07, 0.10, 0.13 and 0.70 of atk_scale (sum 1.00, = the 900% shown). The finisher's own multiplier, legality and SP come from the engine. Not yet logged.

skills.label: Battle skill (Artful Intent)
skills.note: While Artful Intent lasts the battle skill slot holds Initial Stroke (normal_skill_1), then Final Stroke (normal_skill_2) while the Inksoul lasts (BuffData normal_skill_check Switch on EntityBB_normal_skill_id). Team energy (buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp) at the hit, frame 15, on both infliction branches.

hits.note: Entity abilityentity_chr_0036_jsspsi_normal_skill_1 spawned at frame 9, its DamageAction at entity frame 6. Description: "Si deals Cryo DMG and applies Artful Intent, Immobilization, and Cryo Infliction (or Heat Infliction if a Heat element operator is in Team Position 01) on the target." SaveCharTypeIdToIntBySquadSlot slotIndex 0 → SpellInfliction type 2 (Heat) or 0 (Cryo), both enabled (zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37, Laevatain first: the log's Heat bursts at 7550 and 7663 ms show Si's 6565 ms hit inflicted Heat). Immobilization: BuffData normal_skill_hitstop (enemy TimeDilation layer 1 for static_duration 1 s, +0.5 at P1; tag −1065936627, which Jade Vessel keys on). Artful Intent before the damage so this hit is recorded too (zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f needs it).

skills.label: Initial Stroke
skills.note: Battle Skill Move 2: 15 SP (SkillPatchTable), no damage; pulls the Inksoul (trigger initial_stroke). Team energy for its SP at the cast (CreateBuff buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp at frame 0).

skills.label: Final Stroke
skills.note: Battle Skill Move 3: 0 SP, no damage of its own; ends Artful Intent at frame 12 (trigger final_stroke), whose burst then comes through the Inksoul. Not in CharGrowthTable's skillGroupMap; the battle group comes from normal_skill_check's ChangeSkillAction.

skills.label: Combo skill
skills.note: Time dilation (curve ComboSkill) for 0.8 s from frame 0 (read from the data). Entity chr_0036_jsspsi_combo_skill_abilityrange spawned at frame 0: 10 slashes (entity frames 14–41), the final hit at frame 49. The window allows the battle skill and Initial Stroke from frame 20; the entity's hits still land. Energy: ObtainCostAction costType 0 usp (10) at frame 14; the two at frame 49 are disabled, so 10 per cast.

hits.label: Combo slash 1
hits.note: Separate from the other slashes only because the energy grant comes with it.

hits.label: Combo final hit
hits.note: SkillData combo_skill_abilityrange #85–#91: IfElse on potential5 ≥ 1 adds 1 to EntityBB_combo_count, then atk_scale_count = combo_count × atk_scale2_1 + atk_scale2; combo_count is the stacks consumed or absorbed to trigger the combo (the window's eventCount). Verified by hand: zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37 t=14737 = 18.75 × the slash ×1.5 crit, i.e. 4.025 + (3 + 1) × 1.15 = 8.625; zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f t=9331 = 4.025 + 3 × 1.15 with crit and one more Corrosion tick (±1).

skills.label: Ultimate
skills.note: Entity chr_0036_jsspsi_ultimate_skill_abilityrange (Si controlled) or _abilityrange_1 (not; the one every fixture logs), same hit timeline, spawned at frame 0. The amp and the talent's cooldown cut come at entity frame 62 (trigger ultimate_effects), so every slash lands under the amp. The time stop is read from the data. No RefrainObtainUsp in Si's files, so no energy block.

hits.label: Ultimate slashes
hits.note: Match in zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37 (P3 ×1.2, under the logged amp) and zmdlogs-b7b3762d5da8 (P1) but the slash at t=5688, whose buffs the log lists only as boundary effects (buff_common_affixes_vulnerable_crystal and _natural twice each: an instance ending and its refresh starting), which the log check counts as two instances.

hits.label: Ultimate final strike
hits.note: zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37 t=14327 = 4.4999 × a slash (2.16 / 0.48). Poise poise_2 (20).
